heapOrArchives.title: Aujourd’Oui
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Look at the top five cards of your stack. You may bring any program cards among them into your hand. Pay [1] for each card taken in this way, and show those cards to the Corp. Shuffle your stack.

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

root.title: Urban Renewal
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
